subject: general
question: As per the SDG India Index 2023-24 prepared by NITI Aayog, what is India's composite score?
solution:
The correct answer is __**71**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The SDG India Index 2023-24 is prepared by **NITI Aayog**, the policy think tank of the Government of India.
 
• India's composite score in the SDG India Index 2023-24 is **71**.
 
• The index measures the progress of all states and union territories towards achieving the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).
 
• The composite score is derived from the performance of the country across various SDG indicators.
 
• This index helps in identifying gaps and areas that need improvement to meet the SDG targets by 2030.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**

 
 
• The SDGs are a set of 17 global goals established by the United Nations in 2015.
 
• They aim to address global challenges including poverty, inequality, climate change, environmental degradation, peace, and justice.
 
• Each goal has specific targets to be achieved by 2030.
 
• The goals are interconnected and balance the three dimensions of sustainable development: economic, social, and environmental.
 
 
 
• **NITI Aayog**
 
 
• NITI Aayog stands for National Institution for Transforming India.
 
• It was established in 2015, replacing the Planning Commission.
 
• It aims to foster cooperative federalism through structured support initiatives and mechanisms with the states on a continuous basis.
 
• NITI Aayog provides relevant strategic and technical advice across the spectrum of key policies and programs.
 
 
 
• **India's Performance in SDGs**
 
 
• India's performance on the SDGs is tracked annually by the SDG India Index.
 
• The index assesses the progress made by states and union territories on various SDG indicators.
 
• The index helps in identifying best practices and the key challenges faced by different regions.
 
• It serves as a valuable tool for policy-makers to prioritize actions for achieving the SDGs by 2030.
 
 
 
• **Composite Score**
 
 
• The composite score is a summary measure of performance across various indicators.
 
• It is calculated by aggregating the scores of individual indicators, which are weighted according to their importance.
 
• A higher composite score indicates better performance towards achieving the SDGs.
 
• This score helps in benchmarking and tracking progress over time.
